title: ScrollRestoration
summary: Restore saved history positions and scroll new pages after their DOM commits.

sections.title: Parameters
sections.body: Accepts ScriptProps for compatibility, but currently does not use nonce or render a script. Requires application context and the navigation integration that records history keys and scroll positions.

sections.title: Returns
sections.body: Renders nothing. While mounted, sets history.scrollRestoration to manual and restores the previous setting when unmounted.

sections.title: Example
sections.body: Mount once in the root document layout, alongside the application content. mountApplication supplies the navigation integration.

sections.title: Restoration order
sections.body: Waits for an idle snapshot with the committed history key, then schedules a frame so lazy views can finish mounting. A saved POP position takes precedence. Otherwise a hash target scrolls into view; without one, preventScrollReset preserves the current position, and ordinary navigation scrolls to [0, 0]. Positions are held in memory for this router rather than persisted across document reloads.
